g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-301 Ribbon blender 6 cu ft (built in house) · rev B
Bore and spigots Ra 1.6 [63 µin]; rest Ra 3.2
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: P1-301-104 STUFFING BOX QTY 2 - SECTION ON THE AXIS 1:1

g.text: drill Ø8.5 x 25, on PCD 115 [4.528] at 45°
C0.5 both ends of the bore

svg.text: 1. Box: saw Ø160 bar to 62, face, turn OD Ø150 and spigot Ø100 f8 in one setting with the bore Ø80 H8 and throat Ø64 so the spigot (datum A)
2. Drill and tap 4 x M10 on PCD 115 at 45° to the vertical (two studs above, two below the shaft when fitted). Use a drill jig or the mill
3. Follower: saw Ø155 bar to 34, turn spigot Ø80 f8 and bore Ø62 in one setting. 4 x Ø11 on PCD 115.
4. Mark part no. on the Ø150 OD. Fit-check: follower slides into the box bore by hand with no shake; spigot slides into the end plate hole.
5. No sharp edges in the throat (product side): C1 and polish Ra 0.8.
lathe 1 setting + flip face, mill/drill PCD, tap
lathe 1 setting + flip face, drill PCD
